summary: Malibu Boats, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on July 10, 2026. The borrower is a wholly owned indirect subsidiary, and the facility includes a $250M revolving credit facility and a $100M term loan, both maturing July 10, 2031. Proceeds from the term loan were used to repay existing revolving borrowings; $65M remained outstanding under the revolver post-closing. Interest rates are based on SOFR or base rate plus applicable margins depending on leverage, with a commitment fee on unused revolver capacity. This is a routine refinancing of existing debt, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The filing is an ordinary credit agreement amendment.
